desc.zh: 从完整状态的分层搜索推导乐观下界，用 A* 探索并核对答案；再把搜索揭示的两条事实变成要提交的 O(T log T) 连续加速段 DP。
desc.en: Derive an optimistic bound from full-state BFS and explore with A* to check answers; then turn two facts the search exposes into the O(T log T) run DP to submit.

complexity: Run DP to submit: O(T log T) time, O(T) space for target T; the explored A* search is exponential in the worst case (O(D·2^D) time, O(2^D) space, D = optimal command count)

concepts.name: Race Car state-space BFS
concepts.description: Full position and signed speed pairs preserve future actions; unit-cost layers prove shortest arrival.
